_note: Cut sheets for the wiring aid Parts panel. url = manufacturer document (official); mirror = distributor copy used when the maker's server blocks automated fetches. Specs here are copied only from the linked document (SOURCED) or the shop log/ledger; anything else says UNVERIFIED. Copies are NOT stored in the repo or gist: these PDFs are copyrighted by their makers with no redistribution licence stated, so we link only (sha256 recorded for the version checked). Verified 2026-10-22 (curl 200 + part number found in the first pages). Keyed by part id (docs/PARTS.yaml); also_parts = other part ids this sheet covers; cutsheet = old sheet id; kw = text pattern used only by scripts/check_cutsheets.py (diagram clicks use explicit node part ids, not text matching).
